props.name: addLabel
props.comment: Label for the add-row button; a string is translated.

props.name: children
props.comment:
The iterator that renders the rows: map `useArrayInputResult().rows` to
`<ArrayInputRow>`s.

props.name: className
props.comment: Extra classes on the field wrapper.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: The array's default value (seeds an untouched hole).

props.name: helperText
props.comment: Helper text rendered below the iterator; a string is translated.

props.name: itemDefaults
props.comment: Object-row defaults merged into a new row (object mode).

props.name: label
props.comment:
The input label. A string is translated; a ReactNode renders as-is;
`false` renders no label.

props.name: scalar
props.comment: Force scalar-row mode (a `string[]`/`number[]`); DETECTED when omitted.

props.name: source
props.comment: The array field path RELATIVE to the ambient source scope.

props.name: validate
props.comment: Array-level validators (e.g. `minLength`) — composed, first error wins.
